items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1958-05-24
items.q: Did I tell you about reading that book by William Faulkner, the famous prize-winning novelist?

ctx.x: Well, plan it. I had a nice boy in me, and George Boyd, he made it good.
